items.title: Jauan Jennings: Back at practice
items.body_text: Jennings (personal) was not listed on the Vikings' injury report Wednesday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sam Darnold: Officially limited to begin week
items.body_text: Darnold (glute) officially was a limited practice participant Wednesday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jadarian Price: Limited Wednesday
items.body_text: Price (chest) practiced in a limited fashion Wednesday, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DJ Moore: Feeling great following practice
items.body_text: Moore (shoulder) "felt great" after getting in a limited practice Wednesday, Matt Parrino of The Syracuse Post-Standard reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Terrance Ferguson: Tending to ankle issue
items.body_text: Ferguson was limited at Wednesday's walkthrough due to an ankle injury, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
